name: Samut
description: Samut is a human warrior from Amonkhet, a former initiate of the Tah crop who dissented against the God-Pharaoh and became a planeswalker, renowned for her double khopesh and speed magic.

description_citations.text: "Samut". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Samut is a human warrior from Amonkhet, a former initiate of the Tah crop who dissented against the God-Pharaoh and became a planeswalker, renowned for her double khopesh and speed magic.

citations.text: "Samut". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Samut watched her friend Nakht wither and die in the desert, and she later found a glyph in Bontu's Monument that showed her the God-Pharaoh was the plane's destroyer.

citations.text: "Samut", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "The Voice of Dissent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She denounced the God-Pharaoh and the trials, abandoned the Tah crop and was labeled a dissenter, and Hazoret had her imprisoned in a sarcophagus.

citations.text: "Samut", section "The Voice of Dissent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Gatewatch freed her, and she fought beside her friend Djeru in the arena and tackled him out of the way of Hazoret's spear.

citations.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Final Hours she rallied survivors, and with Djeru she helped bring down the Scorpion God.

citations.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Her planeswalker spark ignited when she saved Hazoret from the Scorpion God.

citations.text: "Samut", section "Samut's spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Later she helped Karn, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden shut off the Planar Bridge from Amonkhet, and she was trapped on Ravnica by the Immortal Sun during the War of the Spark.

citations.text: "Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She lost her spark in the Great Desparkening, remained Hazoret's champion, and became spokesperson for Naktamun's living during the rebuilding.

citations.text: "Samut", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Samut", section "Hour of Restoration". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Samut is alive on Amonkhet as Hazoret's champion and a former planeswalker, and she serves as vizier of Naktamun.

citations.text: "Samut", section "Hour of Restoration". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Reality Fracture: card flavor text (Reality Fracture, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Djeru tells Samut they must leave the unworthy behind.
timeline.quote: We must leave the unworthy behind, Samut.

citation.text: Baleful Ammit (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut questions what lies beyond the Hekma and the reach of the gods.
timeline.quote: Don't you ever wonder what lies beyond the Hekma?

citation.text: Evolving Wilds (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut declares she will no longer fight just for the honor of dying.
timeline.quote: I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying.

citation.text: Samut, Voice of Dissent (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut watches her friend Nakht wither and die in the desert.
timeline.quote: Samut watched one of her best friends die

citation.text: "Samut", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument Samut realizes the God-Pharaoh is the plane's destroyer.
timeline.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior, but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Samut", section "The Voice of Dissent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut denounces the God-Pharaoh and the trials, abandons Tah crop and is labeled a dissenter; Nissa spots her.
timeline.quote: She abandoned the trials and Tah crop, and was labeled a dissenter for what she said.

citation.text: "Samut", section "The Voice of Dissent". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut tries to convince Djeru not to enter the Trial of Zeal.
timeline.quote: She tried to convince him not to go to the final trial; the Trial of Zeal .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret has Samut imprisoned in a sarcophagus alongside other dissenters.
timeline.quote: The god called for Samut to be imprisoned, and she was sealed inside a sarcophagus alongside other dissenters.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch frees Samut from her sarcophagus.
timeline.quote: Chandra and Gideon opened her sarcophagus and helped her out.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut fights beside Djeru in the arena.
timeline.quote: Samut ran to Djeru's side, and the two fought back to back, Samut's only goal being Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut tackles Djeru away from Hazoret's spear and Gideon shields them, denying Djeru his death.
timeline.quote: Gideon intervened at the same moment, protecting the pair of them from Hazoret with his invulnerability.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Revelation occurs and the Final Hours begin.
timeline.quote: Moments later, the Revelation occurred, and the Final Hours began.

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut, Djeru and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meris names the lost dissenter Samut, angering Djeru, who explains she chose heresy and was removed; Gideon recalls seeing a woman shouting that the gods lie.
timeline.quote: She is a dissenter ,

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: On the eve of their Harvest, Samut finds Nakht by the river and the friends play-fight, joined by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Samut gave him a playful shove, sending him stumbling back into the water

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nakht confesses his fears that the three will be separated and that his faith may falter; Samut says that questions are part of faith.
timeline.quote: What if my faith falters?

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The trio sneaks out of the Children's Quarters at night, and Nakht reveals he can command water.
timeline.quote: a small gush of water swirled sprang from the fountain and danced around his fingertips.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leads her friends to an old mural of Hazoret and strange fighting forms, which she performs.
timeline.quote: Samut assumed the first stance on the mural

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nakht wonders aloud whether there was a time before the gods, unsettling his friends.
timeline.quote: if there ever was a time before the gods.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru shows his secret, a hole in the Hekma, and Nakht persuades the others to go out and look for themselves.
timeline.quote: working his way through the near-invisible hole in the Hekma

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The three children crawl through the barrier into the desert wastes.
timeline.quote: then dropped to her belly and began crawling through to the other side.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In the desert they find a half-buried statue and ruins, and a gigantic limbed thing in the distance sends them fleeing.
timeline.quote: a looming . . . thing shuffled across the sand.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a ruined shrine they find the word Trespasser freshly carved beneath the God-Pharaoh's symbol.
timeline.quote: Trespasser.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Rotting corpses rise from the oasis and swarm the shrine, which Djeru calls dissenters returned by the curse of wandering.
timeline.quote: From the stagnant water and the surrounding sands, rotting corpses started to rise.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nakht draws the risen away and conjures a whirlpool to hold them while Samut and Djeru escape.
timeline.quote: The stagnant waters beneath him swirled into a whirlpool

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut sees Nakht wither to a lifeless husk, and Djeru tackles her out of sight; they flee back to the city at dawn.
timeline.quote: She heard his soul-rending screech as he instantly withered and decayed

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Years later, the loss hardens Djeru's faith while Samut takes up doubt and searches the ancient parts of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: took up the mantle of doubt and questions

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut finds a sealed chamber in Bontu's Monument and sees the God-Pharaoh named Trespasser.
timeline.quote: The walls of the shadowed chamber spoke of the God-Pharaoh's first arrival on Amonkhet

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut realizes that the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser who caused the calamity rather than saving the plane, and resolves to warn everyone.
timeline.quote: He caused it.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: As Samut sprints from the chamber, dark magic flickers to life across the runes.
timeline.quote: a dark magic slowly flickered to life across the runes.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut hides in an old embalming chamber after fleeing viziers and the anointed, and meets Djeru, who came disguised as a mummy.
timeline.quote: The wholesome face of her friend Djeru emerged

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut begs Djeru not to enter the final Trial, claiming the God-Pharaoh is a lie, but he refuses and walks out.
timeline.quote: Don't go to the final Trial.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut mentions Nakht, and Djeru angrily says Nakht died unworthy because of their foolish trespass.
timeline.quote: Nakht died unworthy , out there in the dunes, because of our stupidity.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
timeline.quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut enters Hazoret's monument and requests an audience with the god.
timeline.quote: I request an audience, mighty Hazoret.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret not to take Djeru's life, and Hazoret questions her right to cage his heart.
timeline.quote: I have come to plead for Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret curses Samut and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
timeline.quote: Seize the dissenter.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut is imprisoned in a sarcophagus among other dissenters, who tell her dissenters are the monsters of the Trial of Zeal.
timeline.quote: The monsters initiates face in the final Trial are the dissenters themselves.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut explains that she needs to save Djeru, believing he could convince a god they were lied to.
timeline.quote: If anyone could convince a god they'd been lied to, it's him.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra free Samut from the sarcophagus, telling her they came to rescue her.
timeline.quote: He explained that they saw her days ago evading capture and came to rescue her.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut forces the group to focus on rescuing Djeru, and Gideon swears to help.
timeline.quote: I swear to help you save the life of your friend.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
timeline.quote: Your time has come

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The dissidents awake in the arena with cartouches of control, and Nissa learns to move against the cartouche by treating it like a leyline.
timeline.quote: They work like leylines

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
timeline.quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The battle magic fades, and Djeru surrenders his khopesh and prays for Samut's glorified death.
timeline.quote: Djeru concluded with his khopesh on the ground, a formal surrender.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret asks Djeru to claim his place, and he accepts, but Samut declines Hazoret's gift.
timeline.quote: Without hesitation, she shook her head.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
timeline.quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru, enraged that his chance at a glorious death is gone, beats on Gideon and weeps that he wants to exist.
timeline.quote: Because I want to exist!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
timeline.quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
timeline.quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Djeru to promise to protect their gods and each other.
timeline.quote: No matter what happens, we protect our gods. We protect each other.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun reaches its final point and the Gate cracks open, then swings wide to reveal endless wastes instead of paradise.
timeline.quote: What lay beyond the Gate were endless, empty wastes.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret if that is paradise, and the god does not answer.
timeline.quote: Is that paradise?

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: A winged demon flies through the Gate and perches on an obelisk, and Samut recognizes it.
timeline.quote: Demons were rare on Amonkhet.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Djeru whether he still believes the God-Pharaoh is benevolent, and Djeru's doubt grows.
timeline.quote: Do you still believe this is the act of a benevolent God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra takes Samut and Djeru onto Tuya as they seek to protect Oketra.
timeline.quote: The two former initiates gracefully climbed atop Tuya

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra weeps for her gods, then tells Gideon the source of the hell is his responsibility to kill.
timeline.quote: Then he is your responsibility to kill.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
timeline.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
timeline.quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks who will protect Hazoret, who tells her to fight and says she will endure.
timeline.quote: Who will protect you , Hazoret?

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru loses faith, declaring the God-Pharaoh lied.
timeline.quote: Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.

citation.text: Djeru's Renunciation (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut urges Djeru to lead people out of the city.
timeline.quote: We have to get out of the city, Djeru.

citation.text: Crash Through (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut battles through the hordes shouting the names of the dead and those she hopes to save.
timeline.quote: Samut battled her way through the hordes

citation.text: Blur of Blades (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Samut rallies survivors to fight for tomorrow whether they believe the God-Pharaoh tested or betrayed them.
timeline.quote: If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!

citation.text: Life Goes On (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Tezzeret to activate the Planar Bridge; Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden defeat him, and Hazoret gives them her spear.
timeline.quote: Hazoret gave them her spear, reassuring Samut about the condition of Amonkhet's population

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and the mortals bring the last two corrupted gods away from Naktamun, repopulate the city and create a new Hekma.
timeline.quote: They repopulated the city and created a new Hekma .

citation.text: "Amonkhet (plane)", section "After the Hour of Revelation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut discovers the Trespasser glyph in the monument and realizes the God-Pharaoh is the Great Trespasser and the destroyer of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Samut realized the God-Pharaoh was not a savior but the destroyer of the plane of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Bontu's Monument", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God and Locust God join in Bolas's plan; the Gatewatch, Hazoret, Samut and the faithful fight the Eternals.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch , Hazoret , Samut , and the remaining faithful fought to repel the crypt's unleashed legions

citation.text: "Crypt of the Eternals", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut leaps to fight back against the monstrous invaders.
timeline.quote: Samut leapt to fight back, determined to protect Naktamun from betrayal and ruin.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Glory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru reunite and rally surviving initiates against the Scorpion God and the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Rallying as many surviving initiates as they could, they fought back against the Scorpion God and the Eternal horde.

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The living bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk; Hazoret vows to stand by the mortals.
timeline.quote: the living managed to bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Eternity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret fights the Scorpion God and is severely wounded but weakens its armor so Samut and others can kill it.
timeline.quote: Hazoret managed to weaken its armor enough for Samut and the others to finish it off.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hazoret leads the remaining survivors of Naktamun into the desert, swearing to protect them and becoming the God-Survivor.
timeline.quote: swearing to protect them as long as she drew breath.

citation.text: "Hazoret", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut's planeswalker spark ignites.
timeline.quote: Samut 's planeswalker's spark is ignited.

citation.text: "Hour of Devastation", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut, a former planeswalker, becomes vizier of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: the former planeswalker Samut now serves as vizier of Naktamun

citation.text: "Naktamun", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut's spark ignites when she saves Hazoret from the Scorpion God.
timeline.quote: Samut's planeswalker's spark ignited when she saved Hazoret from the Scorpion God

citation.text: "Samut", section "Samut's spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
timeline.quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The survivors all feel the pain of a fourth god dying, and Samut tells them four gods are now dead.
timeline.quote: Four of our gods are now dead.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru publicly declares he stands with Samut against the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: I have seen more than I needed to realize she speaks truth.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut resolves to go back into the city to protect Hazoret, and Djeru and other warriors join her while Hapatra stays to guide the survivors into the sands.
timeline.quote: I am Rhonas's broken fang, and I know where to strike to stop the undead and the monstrosities in their tracks.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru fight the Eternal Neheb the Worthy and are beaten back.
timeline.quote: Neheb swung his spear forward, sending a wave of flame at Samut.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.
